verdict_rationale: Test was introduced by PR #811 (E-6-3d PCI-DSS slice) with hardcoded ALLOWED_CHANGED_FILES set. The test runs `git diff --name-only origin/main HEAD` on EVERY PR's CI and fails on every non-PCI PR because their files are outside the PCI allowlist. This created a repo-wide blocker. Option 2 (remove the cross-slice allowlist) is the correct durable fix: PCI-DSS slice already has its own test_e63_catalog_zero_touch + test_runbook_e63_zero_touch invariants that enforce slice scope. Cross-slice allowlist test assertion was always semantically wrong (this should be per-slice, not repo-wide).
